title: Index Build Authorization
limitations: Read time is ungated: retrieve performs no authorization; holding an index is sufficient to search it.
A resolver is trusted to answer truthfully; only the identity of its answer is verified.
No authorization cell is authorized; all 350 remain UNKNOWN.
Eight of fourteen activities have no runtime enforcement point.
A document with no chunks is never evaluated and never reported.
allowSyntheticIndex bypasses the registry in benchmark and retrieval tests by design.
authorizeIndexing checks three activities, so wrapping it makes three checks per document.
D1 remains shim-validated only; no remote D1 or workerd run.
